essence: Therefore, through yoga practice, omniscience and related powers manifest here.
Therefore, such forms are brought forth by one's own playful activity.
Therefore, obeisance is offered to our teacher who is of such nature and possesses Śiva's splendor.
Therefore, the mind is purified by the illumination composed by Rāmakaṇṭha.
Therefore, the purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels has been revealed briefly.
